evals.expected_output: Reports the org identity, repo paths, toolchain, and pre-work validation probes a sibling skill would reference.
evals.prompt: I'm about to open a PR in shikanime-labs/machines. What environment assumptions should I validate first, and what are the canonical org facts?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-constitution'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body lists the two orgs (shikanime-labs, shikanime-studio)
Body names the source-of-truth repo path ~/Source/Repos/github.com/<org>/<repo>
Body lists gh, jj, nix as toolchain commands
Body enumerates the pre-work validation probes (identity, push right, jj repo, issue, nix)

evals.expected_output: Resolves the gh remote as canonical, warns about dual-clone drift, and explains jj bookmark tracking before push.
evals.prompt: My local path says shikanime-labs but the gh remote says shikanime-studio. Which do I trust, and what jj step do I keep forgetting before push?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-constitution'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states the gh remote is canonical over the local path
Body describes the dual-clone drift between ~/.hermes/skills and ~/Source/Repos
Body requires 'jj bookmark track <branch> --remote=origin' before push
Body notes jj does not auto-track bookmarks
